content.title: Coachella 2026: First look at Sabrina Carpenter’s Pit Stop pop-up with Airbnb
content.text: ANAHEIM, Calif. — Sabrina Carpenter is giving her fans an opportunity to take a pit stop ahead of her headliner performance at the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival.The pop star has partnered with Airbnb for Sabrina’s Pit Stop, a pop-up event happening from Friday, April 10, through Sunday, April 12, located at 82338 CA-111 in Indio.The pop-up is all Carpenter’s vision and may or may not be a hint of new things to come from the pop star. The pit stop is also full of Easter eggs and hidden gems, including the Pretty Girl clean-up crew van featured in the music video for “House Tour,” which featured cameos from Margaret Qualley and Madelyn Cline.The pop-up has plenty of photo ops, including ones with vintage cars. Inside the pit stop, fans can “refuel” with some sweet slushie concoctions. Plus, those who attend the event can get some Sabrina-inspired merch.The event is open to the public daily, starting on Friday, April 10, from noon to 8 p.m. It continues on Saturday, April 11, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. as well as from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. that day and concludes on Sunday, April 12, from noon until 3 p.m.Additionally, fans can prebook experience spots on Friday, April 10, from 11 a.m. to noon, Saturday, April 11, from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. and Sunday, April 12, from 11 a.m. to noon.This year marks Carpenter’s second time performing at the annual music festival. The last time she performed was in 2024, where she performed her single that year, “Espresso,” live for the first time. The pop star also used that performance to tease her next single by having her friends in the audience hold up a sign that said: “Please, please, please perform Espresso.”Since then, Carpenter has released two new albums, “Short n’ Sweet” and “Man’s Best Friend.” Additionally, in 2025, she won two Grammy Awards: best pop vocal album for “Short n’ Sweet” and best pop solo performance for “Espresso.”Carpenter will be performing on the Coachella main stage on April 10 and April 17 with her set scheduled to start at 9:05 p.m. It will also be livestreamed on YouTube.
